node: Liquid cooling, heat rejection, battery storage, power controls, inverters, fire safety, and energy management software
summary: Layer 1B expands the site-level data-center reliability stack universe with one high-attention reference leader and two underfollowed/second-order candidates. The chokepoint hypothesis remains that AI data-center density forces thermal, UPS battery, power electronics, controls, and service systems to be integrated as a reliability stack rather than purchased as isolated HVAC or battery products. Vertiv is retained only as a reference benchmark. Modine is a more direct thermal-management supplier with disclosed data-center cooling, chillers, liquid cooling, intelligent controls, and capacity expansion. EnerSys is a second-order battery/UPS resilience candidate where the market may still classify the business as legacy industrial batteries despite data-center demand, lithium validation, higher-density backup needs, and power-continuity exposure. No buy/sell recommendation is made.
